physicalBrowserObservations.truthBoundary: Browser observations were physical and local, but authority/roadmap/lint fixes changed SOURCE afterward. They are retained as superseded local evidence only and do not constitute final-byte A79R1 credit.

closedFindings.fix: Added locale alias to the canonical market-integrity Shield route.
closedFindings.positiveTest: PL/EN/DE route rendered in physical Chromium.
closedFindings.negativeTest: No 404 marker on nine mobile locale/product rows.
closedFindings.remainingTruth: No production or final-byte browser credit.

closedFindings.condition: Timeout could hide the loader while stale content remained under a committed URL.
closedFindings.fix: Single-owner transition recovery now cancels pending RAF/timers and hard-recovers navigation instead of reporting success.
closedFindings.positiveTest: Twenty SPA transitions ended with zero overlays and unlocked main content.
closedFindings.negativeTest: Rapid transition ownership is cancelled on cleanup.

closedFindings.condition: Duplicate main-content landmarks produced invalid focus/loader authority.
closedFindings.fix: Locale layout is the sole main-content owner.
closedFindings.positiveTest: Observed mainIds=1 on final physical route rows.
closedFindings.negativeTest: Duplicate ID count remained zero across stress rows.

closedFindings.condition: Settled provider failure was presented as indefinitely pending without retry.
closedFindings.fix: Fail-closed unavailable state, freshness truth and bounded retry were added.
closedFindings.positiveTest: Physical Real Markets rendered unavailable plus Retry with zero spinners.
closedFindings.negativeTest: No fixture or placeholder was presented as LIVE.
closedFindings.remainingTruth: Controlled 503 browser execution is not credited.

closedFindings.condition: Shield Pro used a flat decorative field rather than recognizable geography.
closedFindings.fix: Bounded monochrome canvas globe uses the existing 16000-point real-land dataset and static open-data fallback.
closedFindings.positiveTest: One ready globe canvas observed on every PL/EN/DE Shield Pro route.
closedFindings.negativeTest: Zero globe canvases on sibling product routes; zero decorative LIVE tokens.
closedFindings.remainingTruth: Visual quality is local evidence, not real-data/provider credit.

closedFindings.condition: Global loader could not observe page-critical data settlement.
closedFindings.fix: Critical roots expose one declarative loading contract and loader waits for a stable frame.
closedFindings.negativeTest: No overlay remained after navigation cycles.

closedFindings.condition: Globe fallback image triggered a development LCP warning.
closedFindings.fix: Critical fallback is eagerly loaded with reserved geometry.
closedFindings.positiveTest: Final mobile session produced no warning/error logs.
closedFindings.negativeTest: Canvas count did not grow across cycles.
closedFindings.remainingTruth: Development observation is not production performance proof.

closedFindings.condition: Top metric cards could still say pending after settled provider failure.
closedFindings.fix: Cards now render localized unavailable truth after settlement.
closedFindings.positiveTest: TypeScript targeted gate passed after change.
closedFindings.remainingTruth: Final physical browser retest was blocked after browser URL-policy shutdown.

roadmapOnlyFindings.summary: Shield and Shield Pro delivery truth can be derived without the full providerRiskDelivery contract.
Failed refresh can leave last data labeled LIVE instead of LAST_KNOWN_GOOD.
Mixed live/demo rows can contaminate aggregate status.
Uncalibrated 0-100 risk score is rendered with percent semantics.
Shield Map scan lacks AbortController and out-of-order response ownership.
Asset modal hardcodes Active independently of market-data state.
Shield Map manual motion toggle does not stop the CSS globe animation.
Shield Map combobox keyboard contract and target size require follow-up.
Clickable desktop rows need native action semantics and consistent focus.
Two Shield Map aliases emit differing self-canonical URLs.
